notes.title: Disc Dimension Spring Update
notes.content:
Greetings Disc Dimension Fans!

As we stride into the blooming season of Spring, we're thrilled to bring you a major update packed with exciting developments and improvements.

Thank you for your continued support! Please consider sharing the game with your friends, and encourage them to Wishlist the game! You can also follow us on Social Media for additional information and content!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XBp8R7gbnS]Join us in Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@mysticdiscgolfer]Tik Tok,[/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@alchemistbrewgamestudios]Youtube[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61554398575411]Facebook[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763708/67f18801c15c60286f92176b94a99c798bd1fd1f.png[/img]

Let's dive right in!

[h1]Release Strategy Update
[/h1]Based on the incredible experience with our first playtest, we're adjusting our release strategy. Instead of the planned Early Access, we'll be launching a series of playtests using Steam's Playtest feature. This allows us to involve you in the development process more effectively while we build out a core feature set. We will still offer an Early Release, but it will come closer to our full game launch.

Stay tuned for an upcoming [b]Spring Playtest[/b] announcement, where you'll get a chance to experience many of the fantastic updates and content we have in store!


[h1]What have we been working on?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763708/52a25ce26d9de0983355eb56ce03797c83846469.png[/img]

[u][h2]Core Experience Updates[/h2]
[/u]
[h3]Training Hill[/h3]
We are in the final stages of developing a robust training field aimed at honing your disc golf skills. Stay tuned as we prepare to unveil this exciting addition!

[h3]Trigger-less Disc Release[/h3]
Our latest feature ensures a more natural disc release mechanism. By simulating real-world grip release dynamics, players can focus on perfecting their arm swing without worrying about the unnatural timing of when you release the trigger.

[h3]Disc Creation Tools[/h3]
We’ve developed in-game tools designed to empower us to create and customize discs. This opens up a world of personalized disc options for players in the future!

[h3]Arm Swing UI[/h3]
We are continuously refining our Arm Swing UI to offer intuitive controls and an immersive feedback experience. The first version is now complete, with further enhancements on the horizon.


[u][h2]Quality of Life Updates[/h2]
[/u]
[h3]Disc Physics Improvements[/h3]
Based on valuable player feedback, we've fine-tuned the disc physics to align with player expectations. Expect smoother glide behavior and less overstability, generally.

[h3]Disc Selection UI Improvements[/h3]
We’ve updated the UI to eliminate unnecessary movements and to hint at the controls available for selection.

[h3]Guided Paths to the Basket[/h3]
Navigate the course with ease using our new Guided Paths feature. Never lose your way again as you follow the shortest route to the basket.


[h2][u]Performance Updates[/u]

[/h2][h3]Engine & Rendering Optimizations[/h3]
Experience improved fidelity and performance thanks to significant upgrades in our engine and rendering systems. Enjoy smoother gameplay and enhanced visuals across the board.

[h3]Temporal Anti-Aliasing Support[/h3]
We've implemented temporal anti-aliasing to address visual artifacts on VR devices with lower screen resolutions. This enhancement ensures a more stable and visually pleasing VR experience.



[h1]What’s coming next?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763708/342cc305d437b3e549c3d40aece7571abe6fbecb.png[/img]

[h3]Disc Collections[/h3]
Prepare for an expanded Disc Collection experience where you can discover, earn, and craft new discs to enhance your gameplay!

[h3]Streamlined Tutorial[/h3]
Our upcoming tutorials, integrated into the Training Field, will guide new players through controls, introduce them to disc golf fundamentals, and provide ample practice opportunities to sharpen their skills.

[h3]Throw Assist Updates[/h3]
Building upon our existing throw-assist feature, we're ramping up with enhancements like trajectory, spin, and angle correction. These updates aim to make the game more accessible and enjoyable for players of all skill levels.

[h3]Course Updates[/h3]
Get ready for fresh experiences with new courses and holes added to the game! Stay tuned for exciting challenges and varied landscapes to explore.

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
We're laying the groundwork for a thrilling multiplayer experience. While there's still work to be done, we now have a solid data foundation to build from. We're dedicated to bringing multiplayer functionality to Disc Dimension to enhance your social gaming experience!

-----

As always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. [url=https://discord.com/invite/XBp8R7gbnS]Join us in Discord[/url] to be part of this incredible journey as we shape the ultimate VR Disc Golf experience together!

Happy Spring Disc Golfing!
[i]Alchemist Brew Game Studios
[/i]

notes.title: Development Update: February
notes.content:
[h2][b]Playtesting[/b]
[/h2]
We're thrilled by the response to our first Playtest! A heartfelt thank you to everyone who has shown interest. For those participating, and even if you're not, we invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/XBp8R7gbnS]Discord server[/url], where we can share in the excitement and gather your valuable feedback.

To express our gratitude, we're offering an [b]Early Access Key Giveaway[/b] (on release) to the first 10 Playtest participants who complete a testing survey (link in Discord) and DM a developer on Discord! Your insights are crucial in shaping the future of Disc Dimension, and we want to reward your contributions.

Invitations will continue to be rolled out in waves for a structured playtesting phase lasting a few weeks (exact end date to be announced). We'll continually enhance and expand the content during this period based on your feedback.

[h2][b]Upcoming Content Updates[/b]
[/h2]
[h3][i]Teleport Movement Support[/i]
[/h3]We will be adding a Teleport style free-movement as an alternative to Smooth movement to help those with VR movement sensitivity.

[h3][i]Left Handed Support[/i]
[/h3]We had a few kinks to work out with left-handed play, which will be rolled out soon.  Apologies to our left-handers, but rest assured we have you covered.

[h3][i]New Holes & Hazards[/i]
[/h3]As we add additional holes to the Elder Forest during the Playtest, we will introduce new magical hazards and challenges.

[h3][i]Disc Collections[/i]
[/h3]Unearth a variety of discs and curate a collection that matches your style!

[h2][b]Upcoming Development Roadmap[/b]
[/h2]
In addition to rolling out new content, we will be developing brand-new features. Here's a look at some things we're working on:

[h3][i]Training Hill[/i]
[/h3]Master the basics, gain advanced insights, and refine your form at the Training Hill. Receive instant feedback to elevate your disc golf skills.

[h3][i]New Course ???[/i]
[/h3]Something exciting is brewing in the Disc Dimension – a mysterious new place awaits exploration. You might want to bring some fire-resistant boots…

[h3][i]Multiplayer[/i]
[/h3]We're currently designing a multiplayer experience, and your input is invaluable. Share your thoughts in the community about what you envision in a multiplayer VR sports game, especially in Disc Dimension.

[h2][i]Early Access Launch[/i]
[/h2]Sometime in the next few months, we will be launching Early Access. The exact date will depend on feedback during the ongoing Playtest. When Early Access launches, the game will be available to purchase, and we will continue to add content for the full release. There will be Playtests in the future which you can sign up for in addition to owning the Early Access title. Look for more announcements about Early Access in the coming weeks!

Thank you for being part of this exciting journey. Your enthusiasm and support fuel our commitment to deliver an extraordinary disc golf experience. Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to dive deeper into the world of Disc Dimension!

Best regards,
Alchemist Brew Game Studios
